entities.summary: Oldřich Lajsek was a Czech painter, designer, graphic artist and teacher of arts. He became a member of the Union of Czechoslovak Creative Artists in 1954. He was the head of an artistic society named The Group of Eight Artists. In 1985, he was awarded the national honour For Excellent Work. During his life, he created over 3,000 productions of which more than 1,800 went to private collections.

entities.summary: Oldřich Lajsek was a Czech painter, designer, graphic artist and teacher of arts. He became a member of the Union of Czechoslovak Creative Artists in 1954. He was the head of an artistic society named The Group of Eight Artists. In 1985, he was awarded the national honour For Excellent Work. During his life, he created over 3,000 productions of which more than 1,800 went to private collections.
